thread:
Tom - Eng Lead: Quick follow from today's all-hands about last week's outage — I've uploaded the RCA and a short action tracker. Please review and add owners where applicable: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-18-major-fallback 

Aisha - Infra: Read the RCA. Need clarity: timeline notes 'autoswitch to legacy' but no config example. Can someone paste the rule that triggered?

Rohit - Runtime: Pasted the eval snippet that caused it to flip: ```json
{"route_policy":"cost_priority","threshold_ms":120,"fallback":"route_to_legacy"}
``` This allowed transient spikes to trigger fallback. We should either raise the threshold or require a traffic-shim check.

Marta - SRE: I'll take the action to tighten the policy and add a canary flag. ETA: EOD Friday. Marking on the tracker. :white_check_mark:

Tom - Eng Lead: A few Qs raised in the live Q&A: (1) Were Dedicated customers impacted? (2) Any short-term mitigations to avoid noisy fallbacks?

Aisha - Infra: Dedicated uses a separate routing plane; they were not impacted. Short-term mitigation: disable the hosted-tier legacy fallback until guardrails are in place — but we should loop in Support before toggling.

Rohit - Runtime: Low-risk short-term: add a 500ms debounce in the policy evaluation and emit a debug metric for eligibility. Config toggle so we can revert quickly.

Tom - Eng Lead: Can we ship that debounce + metric without an infra rollout? Assign owner + ETA please.

Rohit - Runtime: Owner: Rohit. I'll open a PR for a config-toggle change; ETA: tomorrow morning. Will post PR link here when it's up.

Marta - SRE: I'll draft the customer comms and coordinate with Support. Owner: Marta. ETA: Thursday.

Aisha - Infra: I'll audit related routing rules and propose tightened policies by Friday. Owner: Aisha.

Tom - Eng Lead: From the Q&A: (a) How do we observe fallbacks in Console? (b) What's the rollback plan if debounce regresses?

Marta - SRE: Observability plan: tag requests with `fallback_reason` and surfacing in Console request table + traces. Filing a Console ticket now.

Rohit - Runtime: Rollback: flip config toggle + automatic revert to prior routing snapshot. I'll add a step to the RCA playbook for oncall with exact commands.

Tom - Eng Lead: Please ensure RCA includes a short "Customer impact" blurb suitable for Support to copy. Also convert action tracker items to concise Jira tickets.

inc-bot: RCA updated — https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-18-major-fallback. Action tracker: https://redwood.internal/actions/AT-9876

Rohit - Runtime: PR posted to staging: https://github.com/redwood/realtime/pull/4123 (deployed to staging, running smoke tests).

Marta - SRE: Customer comms draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/comm-draft. Pinging @support for review.

Tom - Eng Lead: Any other follow-ups from people who asked during the Q&A and aren't in this thread? @product @sales?

Aisha - Infra: Pinged product and sales channels; will paste any asks back into this thread.

Rohit - Runtime: We'll emit metric `fallback.triggered` with labels model/region/policy. Recommend adding to Reliability dashboard.

Marta - SRE: I'll add the metric to dashboard and create an alert if rate > 5/min sustained for 5m.

Tom - Eng Lead: Final: update the RCA action tracker with owner + ETA by EOD tomorrow. We'll review at the next ops sync. :eyes:

Aisha - Infra: Added owners and rough ETAs to the tracker.

Rohit - Runtime: Added PR link and stage runnotes.

Marta - SRE: Added comms plan to tracker.

Tom - Eng Lead: Thanks all — I'll post a short recap in the all-hands follow-up thread tomorrow morning for folks who missed it. :thumbsup:
